exposure: pulmonary arterial hypertension associated with congenital heart disease
PH related to left heart disease
finding: Maternal and fetal outcomes varied significantly among pregnant women with different types of pulmonary hypertension, with the highest maternal mortality observed in women with idiopathic pulmonary arterial hypertension.
mod_finding: A total of 70.1% of the pregnant women with pulmonary hypertension underwent caesarean section.
